description: This file contains unit tests for the functions 'mergeStreamingText' and 'resolveStreamingCardSendMode', using the Vitest testing framework. It tests the behavior of text merging and message sending mode resolution in a streaming or messaging context.

methods.name: mergeStreamingText
methods.description: Merges two pieces of streaming text, preferring the latest full text or concatenating partials without newlines.

methods.name: resolveStreamingCardSendMode
methods.description: Determines the message sending mode based on reply and thread identifiers.
